title: What's the Capital of France?
statement: The task is to maximize the bitwise OR of n ratings (n up to 2·10^5, a_i up to 10^9), where one operation picks two adjacent unequal ratings and increments the smaller one. Values stay within [min, max] and any element can be raised up to the maximum, so the answer is the maximum with every bit from the highest bit where min and max differ downward set.
